caption: The drawing features a large, bowl-shaped woven basket at the top, characterized by a tan base color with dark brown geometric and pictorial designs woven into its surface. Around the upper rim of the basket, there is an inscription in blocky, capital letters. Below the basket, there is a narrow, curved band bearing a similar color scheme and an inscription in block letters. At the bottom of the image, two shield-like heraldic crests are present: the one on the left has a yellow crown and divided quadrants with yellow, red, and white colors and various symbols including a lion and castle, while the one on the right features a crown above a shield with a red border and what appear to be blue and red designs inside on a grey background. The background of the overall drawing is a pale, off-white color.
title: Indian Basket
